whyItMatters: The Open Source Orchestra DAO is a proposal, not an organization. Watching people talk it through — out loud, with consent, in public — is the point: receipts, not claims.

Every circle is recorded the same way: notetakers first, consent asked on the recording, nothing cut, nothing public until everyone says yes. You can record yours the same way (publicinform.com/#consent).

glossary.meaning: A decentralized autonomous organization — people coordinating through shared, open rules. The Open Source Orchestra DAO is a proposal being talked through in these circles; nothing is on-chain, adopted or funded.
Consent is asked out loud on the recording itself; nothing goes public until everyone has said yes and the transcript has been checked. Takedown first, questions second.
An open circle of musicians, builders and listeners: no ticket, no conductor, every voice counts. It has played on the floor of Ethereum gatherings since Devcon 6 in Bogotá (2022).
Public editions use first names or chosen display names; surnames, contacts and private circumstances are removed.
